hints.text: Move the decimal point two places left. Remember $85$ is really $85.$

explanation: $10^2 = 100$, so dividing by it shifts the decimal point two places to the left.
Write $85$ as $85.0$ so you can see the point, then shift: $8.5$, then $0.85$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Money check
steps: A penny is $\frac{1}{100}$ of a dollar, so $85$ pennies is $\$0.85$ ✓
